declaration: We improve product search ranking for an e-commerce site. Ideas start as offline experiments on click logs; promising ones go to shadow traffic, then an A/B test ramp. Three of us, Python for the ranker and a Go serving layer. Revenue is on the line, so every ramp needs sign-off.
answers: NDCG@10 on a frozen judgment set over three seeds decides offline experiments. The most recent full week of logs is held out and may only be evaluated right before a ramp. The product owner approves each ramp stage. The serving budget is p99 40 ms at 2k QPS. Experiment code is never kept; winners are rebuilt. On-call is shared with the platform team.
